description: Search a bank's memories relevant to a query (BM25 + entities + corroboration + recency; no LLM). The same scorer the pre-generate hook uses; the hook injects only the hits with evidence, and memory::preview shows exactly what it injects. mode lexical/semantic returns one raw arm (plain BM25, or cosine).

bank.description: Bank to search; omitted: the calling session's bank (with the default bank's memories about the user under one its directory chose, and its agent profile's bank, as the hook reads), else the configured default.

include_superseded.description: Also rank superseded/tombstoned records (the history view).

limit.description: Max memories returned (default: the configured recall_limit).

mode.description: `hybrid` (default) is the fused scorer the hook uses. `lexical` and `semantic` return ONE raw arm (plain BM25, or cosine as the score) for callers that fuse arms themselves — consolidation interleaves both so a near-duplicate is never buried by the fused rank.

tag.description: Only rank memories carrying this tag.

Confidence.description: How a memory entered the store.

oneOf.description: Stated directly in the source conversation.
Derived by the extraction model rather than stated verbatim.
Saved explicitly by an agent or a human (highest trust).

Memory.description: One memory item. Serialized whole as a `memories.jsonl` line; replay is last-wins by `id`, so an update appends a full record with a bumped `revision` and a delete appends a tombstoned record (`invalid_at` set) — history is never destroyed, only superseded.

corroboration.description: Times this memory was independently re-observed. Boosts recall rank.

entities.description: Entity handles used as an exact-match retrieval signal.

id.description: Content fingerprint (`fp` + FNV-1a of the normalized text), so re-ingesting the same source reinforces instead of duplicating.

invalid_at.description: Set when the memory stopped being true (superseded or deleted). The record stays on disk and remains queryable with `include_superseded: true`.

pinned.description: Pinned memories are never touched by any automatic path (consolidation, decay); only an explicit `memory::pin`/`memory::update` changes them.

revision.description: Bumped on every appended revision of this id; replay keeps the highest.

stated_at.description: When the fact was last STATED (created, re-observed, text edited). Unlike `updated_at`, pin/tag/entity edits never bump it, so consolidation can order "which statement is current" by it. Legacy records load as None.

superseded_by.description: Memory id that replaced this one, when superseded by content.

tags.description: Topical labels for filtering WITHIN a bank ("iii", "workers", "billing") — organization, not ranking. Normalized lowercase, capped like entities. Old records without the field load as untagged.

Provenance.description: Where a memory came from. Every extracted memory points back into session-manager; nothing in memory duplicates the transcript store.

bank.description: The bank holding it, when not `bank`: the default bank, read under a bank the session's directory chose, or its agent profile's bank.

retrieval.description: Retrieval mode actually used — degradation is explicit, never silent. `hybrid`: `bm25-entity`, or `bm25-entity-semantic` when the query was embedded through `router::embed`. `lexical`: `lexical`. `semantic`: `semantic`, or `semantic-unavailable` (empty result — NOT "no matches") when the query could not be embedded.
